subject: DataScale renewal & GCP private offer — annual billing conversion and capacity increase

Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private Offer for Redwood Inference — DataScale renewal + capacity increase

Hi Hannah,

Hope you're well. We're starting our renewal planning for DataScale's Redwood subscription and would like to move the account to a GCP Private Offer for next term. Key asks from our side: 

- Term: 36 months (start date target 2027-01-01)
- Committed capacity: increase from 200k token-minutes/month to 400k token-minutes/month (2x)
- Billing: prefer annual invoicing consolidated to one PO per year (we can provide net-30 payment terms)

I've attached our internal PO (PO_4521.pdf) and an initial sketch of the numbers. Can you confirm whether Redwood can convert our current marketplace subscription to a private offer with annual invoices? If so, please advise what information you need from procurement and an estimated timeline to have a private offer live in GCP.

Also looped Sophie from the GCP partner team who will assist with marketplace steps on their side.

Thanks,
Liam
---
Liam Carter
Head of Cloud Partnerships
DataScale.ai
liam.carter@datascale.ai
+1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Private Offer for Redwood Inference — DataScale renewal + capacity increase

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear outline and the PO. Yes, we can convert your subscription to a GCP Private Offer and support annual invoicing. High-level next steps from our side: 

1) Redwood needs the billing entity legal name + billing address and the exact PO number you want referenced on invoices (we can use PO_4521).
2) We will draft a private offer pricing appendix and create the offer in the GCP partner console (Karthik will own that).
3) We generate a DocuSign for your signature that references the private offer ID and your PO; once signed, GCP can make the offer active.
4) Onboard/update the subscription to the new private offer with an effective date (you requested 2027-01-01).

Preliminary commercial note: to support the 2x committed capacity we can offer a stepped volume discount with the 36-month term; I'll attach a provisional pricing PDF. Karthik, can you confirm the expected GCP lead time and whether we need any additional partner metadata from DataScale? Monica from CS, I've cc'd you for the onboarding schedule.

Quick ask for procurement: are you comfortable with annual aggregator invoices and net-30? If yes, reply with billing details and preferred contact for PO issuance.

Best,
Hannah
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com

Subject: Re: DataScale private offer — GCP flow and timeline

Hi all — looping in partner/marketplace steps and timeline. Thanks Hannah for the context. Summary and what we need from DataScale to proceed: 

Timeline estimate (typical):
- Day 0: Redwood creates draft pricing appendix and generates private offer in GCP partner console (requires partner action).
- Day 1-3: GCP validates offer metadata; if clean, partner publishes private offer preview.
- Day 4-7: DocuSign routing and signature from DataScale (we prepare DocuSign envelope once offer is created).
- Day 8-10: After signature we request GCP to activate private offer and migrate subscription; target go-live depends on GCP processing but often within 48-72 hours of activation.

What I need from DataScale now:
- Confirm billing/legal info (received)
- Confirm any reseller/partner chain (none confirmed today)
- Confirm whether you want the effective date locked to 2027-01-01 or allow it to go-live as soon as signatures are complete (if you want guaranteed 01-Jan start we need a signed DocuSign before 2027-01-01 and we should complete within the window above).

Operational notes:
- We'll create the private offer with annualized price and invoice schedule. Redwood supports consolidated annual invoice with line items per month for reconciling consumption.
- Monica will propose onboarding dates for usage migration and entitlements update.

I've created a draft package and attached the GCP offer draft for internal review. Also adding the HubSpot deal here for visibility: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/324534/DS-2026-GCP-04

-Karthik
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
